name: Twilio
description: Communications and messaging: CPaaS with REST APIs for SMS, voice, WhatsApp, email, verification and conversations across 30+ products.
access_notes: Free 30-day trial, no credit card, with product-specific free units (e.g. 100 SMS); self-serve upgrade to pay-as-you-go. Auth is HTTP Basic with API Key SID/Secret (recommended) or Account SID/Auth Token; JWT access tokens for client-side SDKs. Some messaging capabilities (e.g. A2P sender registration) need extra compliance steps.
mcp_notes: Official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.twilio.com/docs (public beta, no auth, docs/spec search only — read-only). Twilio Labs also ships @twilio-alpha/mcp, an official local MCP server exposing Twilio APIs as tools using account credentials. No Composio Twilio toolkit found (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/twilio.md and composio.dev/toolkits/twilio both 404).
uncertainty_notes: The hosted vendor MCP covers documentation search only; account actions via MCP require the separate Twilio Labs alpha local server. WebSocket is used in specific products (e.g. Media Streams, Sync) but REST is the primary protocol.

evidence.note: HTTP Basic auth: API Key + Secret recommended for production; Account SID + Auth Token for local testing.
JWT access tokens (signed with API key) used for client-side SDKs like Conversations and Voice.
Free 30-day trial without credit card, product-specific free units, self-serve upgrade from Console.
Official Twilio-hosted MCP server at mcp.twilio.com/docs; no authentication; indexes 1,800+ public API endpoints (docs retrieval).
Official twilio-labs monorepo exposing Twilio public APIs as MCP tools via @twilio-alpha/mcp with account credentials.
Webhooks are core to Twilio: inbound messages/calls and status callbacks are delivered via HTTP callbacks.
